scope: Software integrity of risk, continuation and return-estimate validation; extreme upward paths are not take-profit caps
findings_from_source: Legacy risk training fit and evaluated the same rows, and its runtime reader did not require temporal validation, calibration or checksums
Legacy EV training also exported fit-row predictions as validation; its runtime reader could use unvalidated or corrupted artifacts
EV confidence was fabricated from the magnitude of the predicted return
Family regressors had temporal MAE but no comparison with a mature training-only baseline or token-cluster uncertainty gate
Missing legacy risk returns became healthy negative labels, and absent exit reasons became negative toxic/liquidity labels

implementation.shared_reader: Family and compatibility prediction APIs share checksum, temporal-validation, role, target, calibration and finite-evidence checks. Corrupt or old in-sample artifacts return unknown without aborting the entry path
implementation.cluster_unit: Case-sensitive mint, not decisions or repeated rows. At least 30 independent OOS tokens; probability validation additionally requires at least five positive and five negative token supports. Fit/calibration class support also counts distinct mints, and advisory challenger holdouts require at least 30 independent mints and five positive mint supports
implementation.skill_check: Deterministic 1000-sample token-cluster bootstrap of paired OOS model-vs-baseline loss. Probability baseline is mature training prevalence; regression baseline is mature training median. Positive lower historical loss-improvement bound is required for advisory prediction readiness
implementation.regression_uncertainty: Expose a 90-percent empirical OOS token-maximum absolute-error envelope in percentage points. It is not conditional uncertainty or guaranteed future coverage. Read point and metadata from the same verified snapshot
implementation.confidence: Prediction magnitude cannot fabricate a confidence probability; ev_confidence stays unknown
implementation.automatic_advisory_upgrade: Scanner advisory pipeline revision 2 invalidates unchanged-data fingerprints after this methodology change. A subsequent daemon cycle can reevaluate instead of skipping an upgraded validation pipeline forever
implementation.labels: Missing or nonfinite observed risk returns remain unlabelled. Missing outcome or exit-reason evidence cannot fabricate negative toxic/liquidity labels
implementation.compatibility_training: Existing risk/EV trainer APIs retain configured severe-loss and clipping semantics, use purged token-disjoint temporal evaluation, and export only actual OOS rows. Rank CSVs are explicitly not calibrated probability CSVs. A weak/untimed retrain cannot overwrite a previously validated compatibility artifact
implementation.configuration_binding: Configured risk threshold and EV clipping bounds must match the saved validated artifact. The fixed risk30 API cannot silently substitute a configured risk50 label
implementation.extreme_paths: Runner learning thresholds through 10000 percent remain event labels, not exit ceilings. Continuation regression targets retain finite extreme observed values above 10000 percent. Existing synthetic exit tests cover continued upward paths through 100000 percent
implementation.risk_boundaries: No new buy permission, safety-gate bypass, live enforcement, sizing change or live activation. Existing exact 0.1 SOL paper contract and immutable entry exit-policy snapshots are unchanged

verification.python_runtime: Both checkouts were verified with the existing D:/Dev/Python/memebot3/.venv Python runtime; publishing checkout has no separate .venv
verification.publishing_preflight: PASS: config import, compilation, paper profile and seven empty-data report builders
verification.git_diff_check: PASS; Git reports its existing LF-to-CRLF normalization warnings
verification.qualification: Test training rows, price paths and provider quotes are isolated synthetic fixtures. No observed financial returns or prospective winning model are certified

runtime.source_behavior_change: Pre-existing unvalidated legacy prediction files are preserved but cannot produce an authoritative risk/EV value until valid retraining

remaining_full_goal_requirements: Generalized entry-policy/scanner champion-challenger transport and comparable prospective evaluation beyond the advisory-ranking and paired runner-exit components
Fresh rare-runner, risk and continuation evidence, with a checked automatic model lifecycle; corrected training methodology is not current profitable model certification
Complete architecture, integration, provider and first-launch failure-path audit
Authorized costed prospective full-strategy evidence before any profitability or live-promotion claim
